summary: Chester County, TN 60-ft Aermotor MC-39 in Chickasaw State Forest; NHLR-registered 2023; state rule bars climbing and first flight of stairs was removed.

facts.status_note: Standing at the 8/5/23 NHLR site visit, but the first flight of stairs had been removed

access.note: On Chickasaw State Forest. State rule: fire towers on state forests are not open to the public; photography is allowed but climbing is not

visit.trail_note: Visitors may photograph the tower but may not climb it, per the Chickasaw State Forest page

events.note: Listed as extant on the Tennessee Division of Forestry tower list dated March 26, 2014
First flight of stairs removed after the 8/28/21 NHLR visit; documented at the 8/5/23 visit. The exact removal date is not given
Registered August 7, 2023 as US 1756, TN 60; nominated by Jason Johns

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 639 ft (195 m); Tennessee Landforms lists 643 ft. The story reports both and does not pick one.
The state page covers fire towers on state forests generally. NHLR places this tower on Chickasaw State Forest, so the rule is applied to it.

notes_for_editor: Build year and builder are not in any source read; the MC-39 design spans the 1930s and post-WWII construction per the MPS, so the story leaves the date open. The stair-removal event is dated 2023 only as documented; the removal happened after 8/28/21. Access level comes from the Chickasaw State Forest page (the first fetch was reset; a retry succeeded). The MPS gives design context, not tower-specific history. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads.
